messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "other heart problems"
set: ["other heart problems", "heart failure or other heart problems", "other problems", "other heart complications", "other breathing problems", "other lung problems", "too much thyroid hormone can cause other heart problems", "dangerous heart rhythm problems", "other heart failure medicines", "heart problems leading to falls", "heart problems before starting Adderall", "asthma or other breathing problems", "heart problems or high blood pressure", "heart problems, heart disease, heart defects, high blood pressure, family history of sudden death or heart problems", "tell doctor if have or had heart problems", "tell doctor if you have any heart problems such as recent heart attack"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
